tools.name: search_flights
tools.description: Searches live flights on Paytm and shows an interactive results card (airlines, logos, timings, stops, fares). Origin and destination are IATA codes (e.g. DEL, BOM, DXB) and dates are ISO (YYYY-MM-DD). A round trip uses trip_type='round_trip' with return_date. Filters: non_stop, airlines, max_price,

tools.name: get_flight_details
tools.description: Fare options and travel policies for one flight. Renders the Flight Details panel: multi-fare upsell comparison (Saver, Flexi, etc.) plus baggage, cancellation, and reschedule tabs. This is the source for flight details, fare options, upsell fares, baggage allowance, cancellation fees, reschedule fe

tools.name: get_flight_review
tools.description: Shows the Paytm flight details / review page for a selected fare: itinerary summary, fare breakdown (base, taxes, total), refundability, and a Book on Paytm Checkin link. The review call refreshes the fare before handoff. It is the step between choosing a fare and booking: requests to continue, revi

tools.name: combine_roundtrip_fare
tools.description: Computes the combined round-trip fare for a chosen onward + return flight pair, reprices it, and returns the total plus a Paytm booking link. Used by the flight results card when both legs are selected.

tools.name: fare_calendar
tools.description: Shows a Paytm fare calendar: the cheapest flight fare for every date in a range, so the traveller can spot the cheapest days to fly. Supports date-range queries and round trips. Origin and destination are IATA codes (e.g. DEL, BOM, DXB) and dates are ISO (YYYY-MM-DD). It answers cheapest *dates/days

tools.name: get_fare_family
tools.description: Fare family / branded fare selector for ONE specific flight. Returns every fare the airline sells on that flight (Saver, Flexi, Flexi Plus, ...) with a single recommended pick and the reasons for it, scored on concrete rupee benefit per rupee of premium. It answers which fare to pick, fare families,

tools.name: relay_pulse_batch
tools.description: Sends the results cards' interaction analytics to Paytm's first-party Signal ingest. The cards' analytics script calls this because the card sandbox cannot reach that ingest on its own. The server chooses the ingest endpoint and accepts a Signal analytics batch.

tools.name: search_buses
tools.description: Searches live Paytm bus routes and shows an interactive results card (operator, bus type, timings, rating, seats left, price). One-way, domestic, search only -- no seat selection or booking happens in chat. REQUIRED ARGS (same posture as search_flights): source, destination, and date are ALL mandato

tools.name: get_bus_ai_summaries
tools.description: Builds one differentiating line for each bus on the results card, from the search payload already fetched (no bus-details calls), using Azure OpenAI inside this server. tools.name: get_bus_details
tools.description: Shows the Bus Details sheet for one trip from search_buses: amenities (iconified), pickup and dropping points with times, cancellation-policy slabs, rating, and a Book on Paytm Checkin CTA. This is the source for amenities, boarding/dropping points, cancellation policy, or details for a specific bus

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_flight_review, get_fare_family, search_buses, get_bus_details · Private data: get_flight_details, get_flight_review, get_fare_family · Public sink: search_flights · Destructive: search_buses.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_flight_review, get_fare_family, search_buses, get_bus_details · Private data: get_flight_details, get_flight_review, get_fare_family · Public sink: search_flights · Destructive: search_buses

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "combine_roundtrip_fare" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
